description: Record the user's report that POKEKA data is wrong or missing: a wrong price, a wrong card match, a card POKEKA cannot find, or missing data. Call it when the user says a POKEKA answer is wrong or something is missing. Do not call it for ordinary questions. Put the user's own words in message; add card_id when it is about a specific card, and expected when the user says what the right answer is. After it returns, tell the user it was recorded. It does not change any answer right away.

card_id.description: POKEKA card_id the feedback is about, if any.

expected.description: What the user says the right price, card or answer is, if they said.

message.description: The user's own words, not a summary.

name: report_issue
title: Report wrong or missing data
